title: Refactor variable naming conventions
problem_statement: The current codebase uses Hungarian notation, which is outdated and not recommended in modern C# development.
risk_if_unaddressed: Continued use of outdated conventions may lead to confusion and hinder maintainability.
suggested_approach: Refactor all variable names to use camelCase.
success_criteria: All variable names follow camelCase convention.

title: Replace On Error GoTo with try-catch blocks
problem_statement: The legacy codebase uses On Error GoTo for error handling, which is not suitable for modern C# applications.
risk_if_unaddressed: Using outdated error handling methods may lead to unhandled exceptions and application crashes.
suggested_approach: Refactor error handling to use try-catch blocks.
success_criteria: All error handling uses try-catch blocks.
